section: Warning Event / Error Codes generated during operations:
markdown:
| Error                                                              | Problem                                                                                  | Solution                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| E84: Invalid date Event log only                                   | Invalid date detected at start-up                                                        | Enter correct date and time in settings. For repeated events, download the up to date firmware from merrycheftechnical.com and load on to the oven.                                                                                      |
| E98: Incomplete cleaning Event log only                            | Cleaning sequence not completed by operator                                              | Complete cleaning process as instructed.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| E99: Air Filter Override Event log only (for display see solution) | Operator selected continue when filter was removed (filter microswitch was open circuit) | Check filter magnet, filter microswitch & connections Operator warning message = ' Air filter removed . Please replace the air filter to continue. (By selecting cancel and overriding the air filter monitoring this will be logged.) ' |
